subject: Outcome vignette & quick reference invite
messages:
From: Jennifer Lee <jennifer.lee@retailco.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2029-08-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Outcome vignette & quick reference invite

Hi Sofia / Marissa —

Thanks again for running the POC with our checkout search workload last month. The pilot went very well and we saw clear operational improvements in the short window:

- Median inference latency dropped ~53% (from 320ms to ~150ms) for our 512-token flows.
- Per-request cost estimate decreased ~28% after you suggested the batching + prefix cache changes.
- End-to-end throughput increased ~3.2x during our 95th percentile load window.

Those results are meaningful for our ops team and marketing would like to capture a short customer vignette to highlight the economics and latency gains. Would RetailCo be OK with a 30–60 second quote and a 20-minute video call to record a short soundbite? We can share a one-page brief and a suggested one-liner to make it quick.

Attached: pilot_results_brief.pdf (summary metrics & anonymized logs)

If you're open to this, please let me know any items you want redacted and a couple of windows that work for a short call.

Best,
Jennifer
VP of Engineering
RetailCo
From: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2029-08-14T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Outcome vignette & quick reference invite

Thanks for the quick note and the strong results, Jennifer — really great work on your side getting the test harness tuned so quickly. We're definitely interested in producing a short vignette.

If it helps move things faster, I've attached a very short draft vignette and a suggested 1–2 line quote you can edit. We will:
- Anonymize any internal IDs and redact detailed traffic volumes unless you say otherwise.
- Use the high-level metrics you called out above (latency reduction, cost percentage, throughput multiple).

Would you be willing to review the attached redline_vignette.docx and confirm a time for a 20-minute call? I have availability Tuesday 8/15 09:00–11:00 PT or Wednesday 8/16 14:00–16:00 PT.

Attached: redline_vignette.docx

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Customer Advocacy
Redwood Inference
